+ -- 头脑风暴群聊功能数据库表结构
+ -- 用于存储多Agent协作讨论的会话、参与者和消息
+ 
+ -- 1. 头脑风暴会话表
+ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_sessions (
+     id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+     title TEXT NOT NULL,
+     topic TEXT NOT NULL,
+     description TEXT,
+     creator_id TEXT,
+     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'completed', 'stopped')),
+     config TEXT, -- JSON格式存储配置（终止条件等）
+     summary TEXT, -- AI生成的讨论总结
+     created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+     updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+     completed_at DATETIME
+ );
+ 
+ -- 2. 参与者表
+ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_participants (
+     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+     session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+     ai_role_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+     display_name TEXT,
+     role_type TEXT, -- 角色类型（专家领域）
+     sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+     created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+     FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+ );
+ 
+ -- 3. 讨论消息表
+ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_messages (
+     id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+     session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+     participant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
+     round_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
+     content TEXT NOT NULL,
+     reply_to_id TEXT, -- 回复的消息ID（可选）
+     metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储元数据（token使用等）
+     created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+     FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+     FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_participants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+     FOREIGN KEY (reply_to_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
+ );
+ 
+ -- 创建索引以提高查询性能
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_status ON brainstorm_sessions(status);
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_created_at ON brainstorm_sessions(created_at DESC);
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_creator_id ON brainstorm_sessions(creator_id);
+ 
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_participants_session_id ON brainstorm_participants(session_id);
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_participants_ai_role_id ON brainstorm_participants(ai_role_id);
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_participants_sort_order ON brainstorm_participants(sort_order);
+ 
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_messages_session_id ON brainstorm_messages(session_id);
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_messages_participant_id ON brainstorm_messages(participant_id);
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_messages_round_number ON brainstorm_messages(round_number);
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_messages_created_at ON brainstorm_messages(created_at);
+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_messages_reply_to_id ON brainstorm_messages(reply_to_id);
+ 
```

+ import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';
+ 
+ // ==================== 类型定义 ====================
+ 
+ /**
+  * 头脑风暴会话配置
+  */
+ export interface BrainstormSessionConfig {
+   stopConditions: {
+     manualStop: boolean;
+     maxRounds: number | null;
+     consensusDetection: boolean;
+   };
+   discussionMode: 'parallel';
+   summaryConfig: {
+     enabled: boolean;
+     provider: 'same-as-agents' | 'custom';
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 头脑风暴会话数据库记录
+  */

+   id: string;
+   title: string;
+   topic: string;
+   description?: string;
+   creator_id?: string;
+   status: 'draft' | 'active' | 'completed' | 'stopped';
+   config: string; // JSON字符串
+   summary?: string;
+   created_at?: string;
+   updated_at?: string;
+   completed_at?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 头脑风暴会话DTO（前端格式）
+  */

+   id: string;
+   title: string;
+   topic: string;
+   description?: string;
+   creatorId?: string;
+   status: 'draft' | 'active' | 'completed' | 'stopped';
+   config: BrainstormSessionConfig;
+   summary?: string;
+   createdAt: Date;
+   updatedAt: Date;
+   completedAt?: Date;
+   participants?: BrainstormParticipantDTO[];
+   messageCount?: number;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 创建头脑风暴会话DTO
+  */
+ export interface CreateBrainstormSessionDTO {
+   title: string;
+   topic: string;
+   description?: string;
+   creatorId?: string;
+   config?: Partial&lt;BrainstormSessionConfig&gt;;
+   participantRoleIds: string[]; // AI角色ID列表
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 更新头脑风暴会话DTO
+  */
+ export interface UpdateBrainstormSessionDTO {
+   title?: string;
+   topic?: string;
+   description?: string;
+   config?: Partial&lt;BrainstormSessionConfig&gt;;

+ // ==================== 模型类 ====================
+ 
+ /**
+  * 头脑风暴会话模型
+  */
+ export class BrainstormSessionModel {
+   private db: DatabaseManager;
+ 
+   constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {
+     this.db = db;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 初始化数据库表
+    */
+   async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     // 表结构已在 create-brainstorm-tables.sql 中定义
+     // 这里可以添加表存在性检查或自动创建逻辑
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 创建会话
+    */
+   async create(data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {
+     const id = data.id || this.generateId();
+     const now = new Date().toISOString();
+     
+     const defaultConfig: BrainstormSessionConfig = {
+       stopConditions: {
+         manualStop: true,
+         maxRounds: 5,
+         consensusDetection: false,
+       },
+       discussionMode: 'parallel',
+       summaryConfig: {
+         enabled: true,
+         provider: 'same-as-agents',
+       },
+     };
+ 
+     const config = { ...defaultConfig, ...data.config };
+     
+     const sql = &#96;
+       INSERT INTO brainstorm_sessions 
+       (id, title, topic, description, creator_id, status, config, created_at, updated_at)
+       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)
+     &#96;;
+     
+     await this.db.query(sql, [
+       id,
+       data.title,
+       data.topic,
+       data.description || null,
+       data.creatorId || null,
+       JSON.stringify(config),
+       now,
+       now,
+     ]);
+ 
+     // 添加参与者
+     if (data.participantRoleIds.length &gt; 0) {
+       const participantModel = new BrainstormParticipantModel(this.db);
+       for (let i = 0; i &lt; data.participantRoleIds.length; i++) {
+         await participantModel.create({
+           sessionId: id,
+           aiRoleId: data.participantRoleIds[i],
+           sortOrder: i,
+         });
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     return this.getById(id);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 根据ID获取会话
+    */
+   async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {
+     const sql = &#96;
+       SELECT * FROM brainstorm_sessions WHERE id = ?
+     &#96;;
+     const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);
+     
+     if (rows.length === 0) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;会话不存在: ${id}&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     return this.toDTO(rows[0]);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 获取会话列表
+    */
+   async list(options: {
+     creatorId?: string;
+     status?: string;
+     limit?: number;
+     offset?: number;
+   } = {}): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO[]&gt; {
+     let sql = 'SELECT * FROM brainstorm_sessions WHERE 1=1';
+     const params: any[] = [];
+ 
+     if (options.creatorId) {
+       sql += ' AND creator_id = ?';
+       params.push(options.creatorId);
+     }
+ 
+     if (options.status) {
+       sql += ' AND status = ?';
+       params.push(options.status);
+     }
+ 
+     sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';
+ 
+     if (options.limit) {
+       sql += ' LIMIT ?';
+       params.push(options.limit);
+       if (options.offset) {
+         sql += ' OFFSET ?';
+         params.push(options.offset);
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     const rows = await this.db.query(sql, params);
+     return rows.map(row =&gt; this.toDTO(row));
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 更新会话
+    */
+   async update(id: string, data: UpdateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {
+     const existing = await this.getById(id);
+     const updates: string[] = [];
+     const params: any[] = [];
+ 
+     if (data.title !== undefined) {
+       updates.push('title = ?');
+       params.push(data.title);
+     }
+ 
+     if (data.topic !== undefined) {
+       updates.push('topic = ?');
+       params.push(data.topic);
+     }
+ 
+     if (data.description !== undefined) {
+       updates.push('description = ?');
+       params.push(data.description);
+     }
+ 
+     if (data.status !== undefined) {
+       updates.push('status = ?');
+       params.push(data.status);
+       
+       if (data.status === 'completed' || data.status === 'stopped') {
+         updates.push('completed_at = ?');
+         params.push(new Date().toISOString());
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     if (data.config !== undefined) {
+       const currentConfig = existing.config;
+       const mergedConfig = { ...currentConfig, ...data.config };
+       updates.push('config = ?');
+       params.push(JSON.stringify(mergedConfig));
+     }
+ 
+     if (updates.length === 0) {
+       return existing;
+     }
+ 
+     updates.push('updated_at = ?');
+     params.push(new Date().toISOString());
+     params.push(id);
+ 
+     const sql = &#96;UPDATE brainstorm_sessions SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?&#96;;
+     await this.db.query(sql, params);
+ 
+     return this.getById(id);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 更新总结
+    */
+   async updateSummary(id: string, summary: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     const sql = &#96;
+       UPDATE brainstorm_sessions 
+       SET summary = ?, updated_at = ?
+       WHERE id = ?
+     &#96;;
+     await this.db.query(sql, [summary, new Date().toISOString(), id]);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 删除会话
+    */
+   async delete(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     const sql = 'DELETE FROM brainstorm_sessions WHERE id = ?';
+     await this.db.query(sql, [id]);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 转换为DTO
+    */
+   private toDTO(row: BrainstormSession): BrainstormSessionDTO {
+     let config: BrainstormSessionConfig;
+     try {
+       config = JSON.parse(row.config || '{}');
+     } catch {
+       config = {
+         stopConditions: {
+           manualStop: true,
+           maxRounds: 5,
+           consensusDetection: false,
+         },
+         discussionMode: 'parallel',
+         summaryConfig: {
+           enabled: true,
+           provider: 'same-as-agents',
+         },
+       };
+     }
+ 
+     return {
+       id: row.id,
+       title: row.title,
+       topic: row.topic,
+       description: row.description,
+       creatorId: row.creator_id,
+       status: row.status,
+       config,
+       summary: row.summary,
+       createdAt: new Date(row.created_at || Date.now()),
+       updatedAt: new Date(row.updated_at || Date.now()),
+       completedAt: row.completed_at ? new Date(row.completed_at) : undefined,
+     };
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 生成ID
+    */
+   private generateId(): string {
+     return &#96;bs_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 参与者模型
+  */
+ export class BrainstormParticipantModel {
+   private db: DatabaseManager;
+ 
+   constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {

+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 创建参与者

+   async create(data: {

+     aiRoleId: string;
+     displayName?: string;
+     roleType?: string;
+     sortOrder?: number;
+   }): Promise&lt;BrainstormParticipantDTO&gt; {
+     const sql = &#96;
+       INSERT INTO brainstorm_participants 
+       (session_id, ai_role_id, display_name, role_type, sort_order, created_at)
+       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+     &#96;;
+     
+     const result = await this.db.query(sql, [
+       data.sessionId,
+       data.aiRoleId,
+       data.displayName || null,
+       data.roleType || null,
+       data.sortOrder ?? 0,
+       new Date().toISOString(),
+     ]);
+ 
+     const id = result.lastID || result.insertId;
+     return this.getById(id);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 根据ID获取参与者
+    */
+   async getById(id: number): Promise&lt;BrainstormParticipantDTO&gt; {
+     const sql = 'SELECT * FROM brainstorm_participants WHERE id = ?';
+     const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);
+     
+     if (rows.length === 0) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;参与者不存在: ${id}&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     return this.toDTO(rows[0]);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 获取会话的所有参与者
+    */
+   async getBySessionId(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;BrainstormParticipantDTO[]&gt; {
+     const sql = &#96;
+       SELECT p.*, r.name as ai_role_name, r.description as ai_role_description, r.avatar as ai_role_avatar
+       FROM brainstorm_participants p
+       LEFT JOIN ai_roles r ON p.ai_role_id = r.id
+       WHERE p.session_id = ?
+       ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.created_at ASC
+     &#96;;
+     const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [sessionId]);
+     return rows.map(row =&gt; this.toDTOWithRole(row));
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 删除参与者
+    */
+   async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     const sql = 'DELETE FROM brainstorm_participants WHERE id = ?';
+     await this.db.query(sql, [id]);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 删除会话的所有参与者
+    */
+   async deleteBySessionId(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     const sql = 'DELETE FROM brainstorm_participants WHERE session_id = ?';
+     await this.db.query(sql, [sessionId]);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 转换为DTO
+    */
+   private toDTO(row: BrainstormParticipant): BrainstormParticipantDTO {
+     return {
+       id: row.id,
+       sessionId: row.session_id,
+       aiRoleId: row.ai_role_id,
+       displayName: row.display_name,

+       sortOrder: row.sort_order,

+   /**
+    * 转换为DTO（包含角色信息）
+    */
+   private toDTOWithRole(row: any): BrainstormParticipantDTO {
+     const dto = this.toDTO(row);
+     if (row.ai_role_name) {
+       dto.aiRole = {
+         id: row.ai_role_id,
+         name: row.ai_role_name,
+         description: row.ai_role_description || '',
+         avatar: row.ai_role_avatar,
+       };
+     }
+     return dto;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 讨论消息模型
+  */
+ export class BrainstormMessageModel {
+   private db: DatabaseManager;
+ 
+   constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {
+     this.db = db;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 创建消息
+    */
+   async create(data: {
+     sessionId: string;
+     participantId: number;
+     roundNumber: number;
+     content: string;
+     replyToId?: string;
+     metadata?: any;
+   }): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO&gt; {
+     const id = this.generateId();
+     const sql = &#96;
+       INSERT INTO brainstorm_messages 
+       (id, session_id, participant_id, round_number, content, reply_to_id, metadata, created_at)
+       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+     &#96;;
+     
+     await this.db.query(sql, [
+       id,
+       data.sessionId,
+       data.participantId,
+       data.roundNumber,
+       data.content,
+       data.replyToId || null,
+       data.metadata ? JSON.stringify(data.metadata) : null,
+       new Date().toISOString(),
+     ]);
+ 
+     return this.getById(id);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 批量创建消息
+    */
+   async createBatch(messages: Array&lt;{
+     sessionId: string;
+     participantId: number;
+     roundNumber: number;
+     content: string;
+     replyToId?: string;
+     metadata?: any;
+   }&gt;): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {
+     const results: BrainstormMessageDTO[] = [];
+     for (const msg of messages) {
+       const result = await this.create(msg);
+       results.push(result);
+     }
+     return results;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 根据ID获取消息
+    */
+   async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO&gt; {
+     const sql = &#96;
+       SELECT m.*, p.ai_role_id, p.display_name, p.role_type
+       FROM brainstorm_messages m
+       LEFT JOIN brainstorm_participants p ON m.participant_id = p.id
+       WHERE m.id = ?
+     &#96;;
+     const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);
+     
+     if (rows.length === 0) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;消息不存在: ${id}&#96;);
+     }
+ 
+     return this.toDTO(rows[0]);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 获取会话的所有消息
+    */
+   async getBySessionId(
+     sessionId: string,
+     options: {
+       roundNumber?: number;
+       afterMessageId?: string;
+       limit?: number;
+     } = {}
+   ): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {
+     let sql = &#96;
+       SELECT m.*, p.ai_role_id, p.display_name, p.role_type
+       FROM brainstorm_messages m
+       LEFT JOIN brainstorm_participants p ON m.participant_id = p.id
+       WHERE m.session_id = ?
+     &#96;;
+     const params: any[] = [sessionId];
+ 
+     if (options.roundNumber !== undefined) {
+       sql += ' AND m.round_number = ?';
+       params.push(options.roundNumber);
+     }
+ 
+     if (options.afterMessageId) {
+       sql += ' AND m.created_at &gt; (SELECT created_at FROM brainstorm_messages WHERE id = ?)';
+       params.push(options.afterMessageId);
+     }
+ 
+     sql += ' ORDER BY m.round_number ASC, m.created_at ASC';
+ 
+     if (options.limit) {
+       sql += ' LIMIT ?';
+       params.push(options.limit);
+     }
+ 
+     const rows = await this.db.query(sql, params);
+     return rows.map(row =&gt; this.toDTO(row));
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 获取会话的最大轮次
+    */
+   async getMaxRoundNumber(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;number&gt; {
+     const sql = &#96;
+       SELECT MAX(round_number) as max_round
+       FROM brainstorm_messages
+       WHERE session_id = ?
+     &#96;;
+     const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [sessionId]);
+     return rows[0]?.max_round || 0;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 转换为DTO
+    */
+   private toDTO(row: any): BrainstormMessageDTO {
+     let metadata: any = undefined;
+     if (row.metadata) {
+       try {
+         metadata = JSON.parse(row.metadata);
+       } catch {
+         // 忽略解析错误
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     const dto: BrainstormMessageDTO = {
+       id: row.id,
+       sessionId: row.session_id,
+       participantId: row.participant_id,
+       roundNumber: row.round_number,
+       content: row.content,
+       replyToId: row.reply_to_id,
+       metadata,
+       createdAt: new Date(row.created_at || Date.now()),
+     };
+ 
+     if (row.ai_role_id) {
+       dto.participant = {
+         id: row.participant_id,
+         sessionId: row.session_id,
+         aiRoleId: row.ai_role_id,
+         displayName: row.display_name,
+         roleType: row.role_type,
+         sortOrder: 0,
+         createdAt: new Date(row.created_at || Date.now()),
+         aiRole: {
+           id: row.ai_role_id,
+           name: row.display_name || '未知',
+           description: '',
+         },
+       };
+     }
+ 
+     return dto;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 生成ID
+    */
+   private generateId(): string {
+     return &#96;bm_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;
+   }
+ }
+

+ import { AgentOrchestrator } from '../agent/AgentOrchestrator';
+ import { brainstormService } from './BrainstormService';
+ import {
+   brainstormSessionModel,
+   brainstormParticipantModel,
+   brainstormMessageModel,
+ } from '../../models';
+ import {
+   BrainstormSessionDTO,
+   BrainstormParticipantDTO,
+   BrainstormMessageDTO,
+ } from '../../models/Brainstorm';
+ import { AgentExecutionResult } from '../agent/AgentOrchestrator';
+ import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
+ 
+ /**
+  * 头脑风暴编排器
+  * 负责并行调度多个 Agent 进行讨论
+  */
+ export class BrainstormOrchestrator {
+   private agentOrchestrator: AgentOrchestrator;
+   private activeSessions: Map&lt;string, boolean&gt; = new Map();
+ 
+   constructor() {
+     this.agentOrchestrator = new AgentOrchestrator();
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 启动讨论会话
+    */
+   async startSession(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     // 检查会话是否存在
+     const session = await brainstormSessionModel.getById(sessionId);
+     
+     if (session.status === 'active') {
+       throw new Error('会话已在运行中');
+     }
+ 
+     if (session.status === 'completed' || session.status === 'stopped') {
+       throw new Error('会话已结束，无法重新启动');
+     }
+ 
+     // 检查参与者
+     const participants = await brainstormParticipantModel.getBySessionId(sessionId);
+     if (participants.length === 0) {
+       throw new Error('会话没有参与者');
+     }
+ 
+     // 更新状态为 active
+     await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, { status: 'active' });
+     this.activeSessions.set(sessionId, true);
+ 
+     try {
+       // 开始讨论循环
+       await this.runDiscussionLoop(sessionId);
+     } catch (error) {
+       // 发生错误时停止会话
+       await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, { status: 'stopped' });
+       this.activeSessions.delete(sessionId);
+       throw error;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 停止讨论会话
+    */
+   async stopSession(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     this.activeSessions.set(sessionId, false);
+     await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, { status: 'stopped' });
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 执行讨论循环
+    */
+   private async runDiscussionLoop(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     let roundNumber = 1;
+     const MAX_ROUND_TIME = 600000; // 10分钟整轮超时
+ 
+     while (this.activeSessions.get(sessionId)) {
+       const roundStartTime = Date.now();
+ 
+       // 检查是否应该停止
+       const shouldStop = await this.shouldStop(sessionId);
+       if (shouldStop.stop) {
+         console.log(&#96;会话 ${sessionId} 停止: ${shouldStop.reason}&#96;);
+         break;
+       }
+ 
+       // 执行一轮讨论
+       try {
+         await this.executeRound(sessionId, roundNumber);
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error(&#96;轮次 ${roundNumber} 执行失败:&#96;, error);
+         // 继续下一轮，不中断整个讨论
+       }
+ 
+       // 检查轮次超时
+       const roundElapsed = Date.now() - roundStartTime;
+       if (roundElapsed &gt; MAX_ROUND_TIME) {
+         console.warn(&#96;轮次 ${roundNumber} 超时，停止讨论&#96;);
+         break;
+       }
+ 
+       roundNumber++;
+     }
+ 
+     // 讨论结束，更新状态
+     await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, { status: 'completed' });
+     this.activeSessions.delete(sessionId);
+ 
+     // 生成总结
+     try {
+       await this.generateSummary(sessionId);
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('生成总结失败:', error);
+       // 总结失败不影响讨论结果
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 执行一轮讨论
+    */
+   async executeRound(sessionId: string, roundNumber: number): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {
+     const session = await brainstormSessionModel.getById(sessionId);
+     const participants = await brainstormParticipantModel.getBySessionId(sessionId);
+ 
+     // 获取历史消息（用于构建上下文）
+     const historyMessages = await brainstormMessageModel.getBySessionId(sessionId);
+ 
+     // 构建每个参与者的查询（包含话题和历史讨论）
+     const queries = this.buildQueriesForParticipants(session, participants, historyMessages, roundNumber);
+ 
+     // 并行调用所有 Agent
+     const agentPromises = participants.map(async (participant, index) =&gt; {
+       const query = queries[index];
+       const conversationId = &#96;${sessionId}_${participant.id}&#96;;
+ 
+       try {
+         const result = await this.agentOrchestrator.executeAgent(
+           participant.aiRoleId,
+           query,
+           conversationId,
+           {
+             topic: session.topic,
+             description: session.description,
+             roundNumber,
+             participantName: participant.displayName || participant.aiRole?.name || '专家',
+           }
+         );
+ 
+         // 保存消息
+         return await brainstormMessageModel.create({
+           sessionId,
+           participantId: participant.id,
+           roundNumber,
+           content: result.content,
+           metadata: {
+             promptTokens: result.usage.promptTokens,
+             completionTokens: result.usage.completionTokens,
+             totalTokens: result.usage.totalTokens,
+             model: result.metadata?.model,
+             finishReason: result.metadata?.finishReason,
+           },
+         });
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error(&#96;参与者 ${participant.id} 执行失败:&#96;, error);
+         // 返回错误消息
+         return await brainstormMessageModel.create({
+           sessionId,
+           participantId: participant.id,
+           roundNumber,
+           content: &#96;抱歉，我在思考这个问题时遇到了困难。${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,
+           metadata: {
+             error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',
+           },
+         });
+       }
+     });
+ 
+     // 等待所有 Agent 完成（使用 allSettled 避免单个失败影响整体）
+     const results = await Promise.allSettled(agentPromises);
+     const messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[] = [];
+ 
+     for (const result of results) {
+       if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {
+         messages.push(result.value);
+       } else {
+         console.error('Agent 执行失败:', result.reason);
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     return messages;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 为参与者构建查询
+    */
+   private buildQueriesForParticipants(
+     session: BrainstormSessionDTO,
+     participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],
+     historyMessages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],
+     roundNumber: number
+   ): string[] {
+     // 构建历史讨论记录文本
+     const historyText = this.formatHistoryMessages(historyMessages, participants);
+ 
+     // 为每个参与者生成查询
+     return participants.map((participant, index) =&gt; {
+       const participantName = participant.displayName || participant.aiRole?.name || '专家';
+       const roleType = participant.roleType || participant.aiRole?.description || '';
+ 
+       let query = &#96;讨论话题：${session.topic}\n&#96;;
+       
+       if (session.description) {
+         query += &#96;话题描述：${session.description}\n&#96;;
+       }
+ 
+       query += &#96;\n你的角色：${participantName}&#96;;
+       if (roleType) {
+         query += &#96;（${roleType}）&#96;;
+       }
+       query += &#96;\n&#96;;
+ 
+       if (historyText) {
+         query += &#96;\n历史讨论记录：\n${historyText}\n&#96;;
+       }
+ 
+       if (roundNumber === 1) {
+         query += &#96;\n请从你的专业角度发表观点，可以：\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;1. 提出新的见解\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;2. 分析问题的关键点\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;3. 提供具体建议\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;4. 指出潜在问题或风险\n&#96;;
+       } else {
+         query += &#96;\n请继续参与讨论，可以：\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;1. 补充其他专家的观点\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;2. 提出不同角度的看法\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;3. 指出潜在问题或风险\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;4. 提供更深入的分析\n&#96;;
+         query += &#96;5. 尝试总结或提出共识点\n&#96;;
+       }
+ 
+       query += &#96;\n请用简洁、专业的语言表达你的观点。&#96;;
+ 
+       return query;
+     });
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 格式化历史消息
+    */
+   private formatHistoryMessages(
+     messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],
+     participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[]
+   ): string {
+     if (messages.length === 0) {
+       return '';
+     }
+ 
+     // 按轮次分组
+     const messagesByRound = new Map&lt;number, BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt;();
+     for (const msg of messages) {
+       if (!messagesByRound.has(msg.roundNumber)) {
+         messagesByRound.set(msg.roundNumber, []);
+       }
+       messagesByRound.get(msg.roundNumber)!.push(msg);
+     }
+ 
+     // 构建文本
+     const lines: string[] = [];
+     const sortedRounds = Array.from(messagesByRound.keys()).sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);
+ 
+     for (const round of sortedRounds) {
+       lines.push(&#96;[轮次 ${round}]&#96;);
+       const roundMessages = messagesByRound.get(round)!;
+       
+       for (const msg of roundMessages) {
+         const participant = participants.find(p =&gt; p.id === msg.participantId);
+         const name = participant?.displayName || participant?.aiRole?.name || '未知';
+         lines.push(&#96;- ${name}: ${msg.content}&#96;);
+       }
+       lines.push('');
+     }
+ 
+     return lines.join('\n');
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 判断是否应该停止
+    */
+   async shouldStop(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;{ stop: boolean; reason?: string }&gt; {
+     const session = await brainstormSessionModel.getById(sessionId);
+ 
+     // 检查手动停止
+     if (!this.activeSessions.get(sessionId)) {
+       return { stop: true, reason: '用户手动停止' };
+     }
+ 
+     // 检查最大轮次
+     const maxRounds = session.config.stopConditions.maxRounds;
+     if (maxRounds !== null) {
+       const currentRound = await brainstormMessageModel.getMaxRoundNumber(sessionId);
+       if (currentRound &gt;= maxRounds) {
+         return { stop: true, reason: &#96;达到最大轮次限制: ${maxRounds}&#96; };
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // 共识检测（V2功能，暂时不实现）
+     if (session.config.stopConditions.consensusDetection) {
+       // TODO: 实现共识检测逻辑
+     }
+ 
+     return { stop: false };
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 生成讨论总结
+    */
+   async generateSummary(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {
+     const session = await brainstormSessionModel.getById(sessionId);
+     
+     if (!session.config.summaryConfig.enabled) {
+       return '';
+     }
+ 
+     const participants = await brainstormParticipantModel.getBySessionId(sessionId);
+     const messages = await brainstormMessageModel.getBySessionId(sessionId);
+ 
+     if (messages.length === 0) {
+       return '讨论尚未开始或没有消息记录。';
+     }
+ 
+     // 构建总结提示词
+     const historyText = this.formatHistoryMessages(messages, participants);
+     const summaryPrompt = &#96;请对以下头脑风暴讨论进行总结：
+ 
+ 讨论话题：${session.topic}
+ ${session.description ? &#96;话题描述：${session.description}\n&#96; : ''}
+ 
+ 参与专家：
+ ${participants.map((p, i) =&gt; &#96;${i + 1}. ${p.displayName || p.aiRole?.name || '专家'}${p.roleType ? &#96;（${p.roleType}）&#96; : ''}&#96;).join('\n')}
+ 
+ 讨论记录：
+ ${historyText}
+ 
+ 请提供一份结构化的总结，包括：
+ 1. 核心观点汇总（列出各方主要观点）
+ 2. 共识点（各方一致认同的观点）
+ 3. 分歧点（如有不同意见，列出关键分歧）
+ 4. 建议结论（基于讨论提出的建议或结论）
+ 
+ 请用简洁、专业的语言撰写总结。&#96;;
+ 
+     try {
+       // 使用第一个参与者的 Agent 来生成总结（或可以配置专门的总结 Agent）
+       const summaryRoleId = participants[0]?.aiRoleId;
+       if (!summaryRoleId) {
+         throw new Error('没有可用的 Agent 生成总结');
+       }
+ 
+       const result = await this.agentOrchestrator.executeAgent(
+         summaryRoleId,
+         summaryPrompt,
+         &#96;${sessionId}_summary&#96;,
+         {}
+       );
+ 
+       const summary = result.content;
+       
+       // 保存总结
+       await brainstormSessionModel.updateSummary(sessionId, summary);
+       
+       return summary;
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('生成总结失败:', error);
+       throw new Error(&#96;生成总结失败: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;);
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * 检查会话是否在运行
+    */
+   isSessionActive(sessionId: string): boolean {
+     return this.activeSessions.get(sessionId) === true;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 导出单例
+ export const brainstormOrchestrator = new BrainstormOrchestrator();
+

+   };

+     provider: 'same-as-agents' | 'custom';

+ import { apiClient, type ApiResponse } from "@/shared/lib/api/apiClient";
+ import type {
+   BrainstormSession,
+   CreateBrainstormSessionDTO,
+   UpdateBrainstormSessionDTO,
+   AddParticipantDTO,

+ /**
+  * 头脑风暴 API 服务
+  */
+ export const brainstormService = {
+   /**
+    * 创建会话
+    */
+   async createSession(data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSession&gt; {
+     const response = await apiClient.post&lt;ApiResponse&lt;BrainstormSession&gt;&gt;(
+       "/brainstorm/sessions",
+       data
+     );
+     if (!response.success || !response.data) {
+       throw new Error(response.error || response.message || "创建会话失败");
+     }
+     return response.data;
+   },
+ 
+   /**
+    * 获取会话列表
+    */
+   async listSessions(options: {
+     creatorId?: string;
+     status?: string;
+     limit?: number;
+     offset?: number;
+   } = {}): Promise&lt;BrainstormSession[]&gt; {
+     const params = new URLSearchParams();
+     if (options.creatorId) params.append("creatorId", options.creatorId);
+     if (options.status) params.append("status", options.status);
+     if (options.limit) params.append("limit", options.limit.toString());
+     if (options.offset) params.append("offset", options.offset.toString());
+ 
+     const response = await apiClient.get&lt;ApiResponse&lt;BrainstormSession[]&gt;&gt;(
+       &#96;/brainstorm/sessions?${params.toString()}&#96;
+     );
+     if (!response.success || !response.data) {
+       throw new Error(response.error || response.message || "获取会话列表失败");
+     }
+     return response.data;
+   },
+ 
+   /**
+    * 获取会话详情
+    */
+   async getSession(id: string): Promise&lt;BrainstormSession&gt; {
+     const response = await apiClient.get&lt;ApiResponse&lt;BrainstormSession&gt;&gt;(
+       &#96;/brainstorm/sessions/${id}&#96;
+     );
+     if (!response.success || !response.data) {
+       throw new Error(response.error || response.message || "获取会话详情失败");

+

+       data

+     if (!response.success || !response.data) {

+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { Search, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';
+ import aiRoleService from '@/services/aiRoleService';
+ import { AIRoleConfig } from '@/types/aiRole';
+ 
+ interface ExpertSelectorProps {
+   selectedRoleIds: string[];
+   onChange: (roleIds: string[]) =&gt; void;
+   disabled?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export const ExpertSelector: React.FC&lt;ExpertSelectorProps&gt; = ({
+   selectedRoleIds,
+   onChange,
+   disabled = false,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const [roles, setRoles] = useState&lt;AIRoleConfig[]&gt;([]);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadRoles();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const loadRoles = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setLoading(true);
+       const result = await aiRoleService.getAllRoles();
+       if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {
+         // 只显示已启用的角色
+         const enabledRoles = result.data.filter(role =&gt; role.enabled);
+         setRoles(enabledRoles);
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('加载AI角色失败:', error);
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const filteredRoles = roles.filter(role =&gt;
+     role.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
+     role.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
+   );
+ 
+   const toggleRole = (roleId: string) =&gt; {
+     if (disabled) return;
+     
+     if (selectedRoleIds.includes(roleId)) {
+       onChange(selectedRoleIds.filter(id =&gt; id !== roleId));
+     } else {
+       onChange([...selectedRoleIds, roleId]);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   if (loading) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-center p-8"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-gray-900"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="space-y-4"&gt;
+       {/* 搜索框 */}
+       &lt;div className="relative"&gt;
+         &lt;Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+         &lt;input
+           type="text"
+           placeholder="搜索专家角色..."
+           value={searchTerm}
+           onChange={(e) =&gt; setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
+           className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
+           disabled={disabled}
+         /&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 角色列表 */}
+       &lt;div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto border border-gray-200 rounded-lg"&gt;
+         {filteredRoles.length === 0 ? (
+           &lt;div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500"&gt;
+             {searchTerm ? '未找到匹配的角色' : '暂无可用的AI角色'}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         ) : (
+           &lt;div className="divide-y divide-gray-200"&gt;
+             {filteredRoles.map((role) =&gt; {
+               const isSelected = selectedRoleIds.includes(role.id);
+               return (
+                 &lt;div
+                   key={role.id}
+                   onClick={() =&gt; toggleRole(role.id)}
+                   className={&#96;p-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors ${
+                     isSelected ? 'bg-blue-50' : ''
+                   } ${disabled ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : ''}&#96;}
+                 &gt;
+                   &lt;div className="flex items-start justify-between"&gt;
+                     &lt;div className="flex items-start space-x-3 flex-1"&gt;
+                       {role.avatar ? (
+                         &lt;img
+                           src={role.avatar}
+                           alt={role.name}
+                           className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover"
+                         /&gt;
+                       ) : (
+                         &lt;div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center"&gt;
+                           &lt;span className="text-gray-500 text-sm font-medium"&gt;
+                             {role.name.charAt(0)}
+                           &lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                       )}
+                       &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
+                         &lt;div className="font-medium text-gray-900"&gt;{role.name}&lt;/div&gt;
+                         {role.description &amp;&amp; (
+                           &lt;div className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1 line-clamp-2"&gt;
+                             {role.description}
+                           &lt;/div&gt;
+                         )}
+                       &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div className="ml-2"&gt;
+                       {isSelected ? (
+                         &lt;div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-blue-500 flex items-center justify-center"&gt;
+                           &lt;Check className="w-3 h-3 text-white" /&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                       ) : (
+                         &lt;div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-300" /&gt;
+                       )}
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               );
+             })}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 已选角色提示 */}
+       {selectedRoleIds.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className="text-sm text-gray-600"&gt;
+           已选择 {selectedRoleIds.length} 个专家角色
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+

+ import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
+ import { BrainstormMessage, BrainstormParticipant } from '@/types/brainstorm';
+ import { Bot, User } from 'lucide-react';
+ 
+ interface BrainstormMessageListProps {
+   messages: BrainstormMessage[];
+   participants?: BrainstormParticipant[];
+   autoScroll?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export const BrainstormMessageList: React.FC&lt;BrainstormMessageListProps&gt; = ({
+   messages,
+   participants = [],
+   autoScroll = true,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const messagesEndRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
+   const messagesByRound = new Map&lt;number, BrainstormMessage[]&gt;();
+ 
+   // 按轮次分组消息
+   messages.forEach((msg) =&gt; {
+     if (!messagesByRound.has(msg.roundNumber)) {
+       messagesByRound.set(msg.roundNumber, []);
+     }
+     messagesByRound.get(msg.roundNumber)!.push(msg);
+   });
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (autoScroll) {
+       messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
+     }
+   }, [messages, autoScroll]);
+ 
+   const getParticipant = (participantId: number): BrainstormParticipant | undefined =&gt; {
+     return participants.find((p) =&gt; p.id === participantId);
+   };
+ 
+   const getParticipantName = (message: BrainstormMessage): string =&gt; {
+     const participant = getParticipant(message.participantId);
+     return (
+       participant?.displayName ||
+       participant?.aiRole?.name ||
+       message.participant?.displayName ||
+       message.participant?.aiRole?.name ||
+       '未知专家'
+     );
+   };
+ 
+   const getParticipantAvatar = (message: BrainstormMessage): string | undefined =&gt; {
+     const participant = getParticipant(message.participantId);
+     return participant?.aiRole?.avatar || message.participant?.aiRole?.avatar;
+   };
+ 
+   if (messages.length === 0) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64 text-gray-500"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="text-center"&gt;
+           &lt;Bot className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 text-gray-300" /&gt;
+           &lt;p&gt;讨论尚未开始&lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="space-y-6"&gt;
+       {Array.from(messagesByRound.keys())
+         .sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b)
+         .map((roundNumber) =&gt; {
+           const roundMessages = messagesByRound.get(roundNumber)!;
+           return (
+             &lt;div key={roundNumber} className="space-y-4"&gt;
+               {/* 轮次标题 */}
+               &lt;div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium"&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="flex-1 border-t border-gray-200"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;第 {roundNumber} 轮讨论&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="flex-1 border-t border-gray-200"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+               {/* 该轮次的消息 */}
+               &lt;div className="space-y-3"&gt;
+                 {roundMessages.map((message) =&gt; {
+                   const participantName = getParticipantName(message);
+                   const avatar = getParticipantAvatar(message);
+                   const hasError = message.metadata?.error;
+ 
+                   return (
+                     &lt;div
+                       key={message.id}
+                       className={&#96;flex items-start space-x-3 p-4 rounded-lg ${
+                         hasError ? 'bg-red-50 border border-red-200' : 'bg-white border border-gray-200'
+                       }&#96;}
+                     &gt;
+                       {/* 头像 */}
+                       &lt;div className="flex-shrink-0"&gt;
+                         {avatar ? (
+                           &lt;img
+                             src={avatar}
+                             alt={participantName}
+                             className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover"
+                           /&gt;
+                         ) : (
+                           &lt;div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-100 flex items-center justify-center"&gt;
+                             &lt;Bot className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" /&gt;
+                           &lt;/div&gt;
+                         )}
+                       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                       {/* 消息内容 */}
+                       &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
+                         &lt;div className="flex items-center space-x-2 mb-1"&gt;
+                           &lt;span className="font-medium text-gray-900"&gt;{participantName}&lt;/span&gt;
+                           &lt;span className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;
+                             {new Date(message.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', {
+                               hour: '2-digit',
+                               minute: '2-digit',
+                             })}
+                           &lt;/span&gt;

+ import React, { useState } from 'react';
+ import { Copy, Check, Download, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
+ import { toast } from 'sonner';
+ 
+ interface BrainstormSummaryProps {
+   summary: string;
+   sessionTitle?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export const BrainstormSummary: React.FC&lt;BrainstormSummaryProps&gt; = ({
+   summary,
+   sessionTitle = '讨论总结',
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
+ 
+   const handleCopy = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(summary);
+       setCopied(true);
+       toast.success('已复制到剪贴板');
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; setCopied(false), 2000);
+     } catch (error) {
+       toast.error('复制失败');
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleExport = () =&gt; {
+     const blob = new Blob([summary], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
+     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
+     const link = document.createElement('a');
+     link.href = url;
+     link.download = &#96;${sessionTitle}_总结_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.txt&#96;;
+     document.body.appendChild(link);
+     link.click();
+     document.body.removeChild(link);
+     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+     toast.success('导出成功');
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-6"&gt;
+       &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4"&gt;
+         &lt;h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2"&gt;
+           &lt;FileText className="w-5 h-5" /&gt;
+           &lt;span&gt;讨论总结&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/h3&gt;
+         &lt;div className="flex items-center space-x-2"&gt;
+           &lt;button
+             onClick={handleCopy}
+             className="flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
+           &gt;
+             {copied ? (
+               &lt;&gt;
+                 &lt;Check className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" /&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;已复制&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/&gt;
+             ) : (
+               &lt;&gt;

+ import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
+ import { Plus, Play, Square, RefreshCw, FileText, Users, MessageSquare, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
+ import { brainstormService } from '@/services/brainstormService';
+ import { BrainstormSession, BrainstormMessage, CreateBrainstormSessionDTO } from '@/types/brainstorm';
+ import { BrainstormSetupModal } from '@/components/brainstorm/BrainstormSetupModal';
+ import { BrainstormMessageList } from '@/components/brainstorm/BrainstormMessageList';
+ import { BrainstormSummary } from '@/components/brainstorm/BrainstormSummary';
+ import TopNavigation from '@/components/TopNavigation';
+ import { toast } from 'sonner';
+ 
+ const BrainstormPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {
+   const [sessions, setSessions] = useState&lt;BrainstormSession[]&gt;([]);
+   const [selectedSession, setSelectedSession] = useState&lt;BrainstormSession | null&gt;(null);
+   const [messages, setMessages] = useState&lt;BrainstormMessage[]&gt;([]);
+   const [isSetupModalOpen, setIsSetupModalOpen] = useState(false);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
+   const [loadingMessages, setLoadingMessages] = useState(false);
+   const [pollingInterval, setPollingInterval] = useState&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null);
+   const messagesEndRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
+ 
+   // 加载会话列表
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadSessions();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   // 当选中会话变化时，加载消息
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (selectedSession) {
+       loadMessages(selectedSession.id);
+       startPolling(selectedSession.id);
+     } else {
+       stopPolling();
+     }
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       stopPolling();
+     };
+   }, [selectedSession?.id]);
+ 
+   const loadSessions = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setLoading(true);
+       const data = await brainstormService.listSessions();
+       setSessions(data);
+       
+       // 如果有选中的会话，更新它
+       if (selectedSession) {
+         const updated = data.find(s =&gt; s.id === selectedSession.id);
+         if (updated) {
+           setSelectedSession(updated);
+         }
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('加载会话列表失败:', error);
+       toast.error('加载会话列表失败');
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const loadMessages = async (sessionId: string) =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setLoadingMessages(true);
+       const data = await brainstormService.getMessages(sessionId);
+       setMessages(data);
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('加载消息失败:', error);
+       toast.error('加载消息失败');
+     } finally {
+       setLoadingMessages(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const startPolling = (sessionId: string) =&gt; {
+     // 如果会话是活跃状态，每3秒轮询一次
+     const interval = setInterval(async () =&gt; {
+       try {
+         const status = await brainstormService.getSessionStatus(sessionId);
+         if (status.isActive || status.status === 'active') {
+           await loadMessages(sessionId);
+           // 同时更新会话状态
+           const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(sessionId);
+           setSelectedSession(updated);
+         } else {
+           // 讨论已结束，停止轮询
+           stopPolling();
+           await loadMessages(sessionId);
+           const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(sessionId);
+           setSelectedSession(updated);
+         }
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error('轮询失败:', error);
+       }
+     }, 3000);
+ 
+     setPollingInterval(interval);
+   };
+ 
+   const stopPolling = () =&gt; {
+     if (pollingInterval) {
+       clearInterval(pollingInterval);
+       setPollingInterval(null);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleCreateSession = async (data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO) =&gt; {
+     try {
+       const session = await brainstormService.createSession(data);
+       setSessions([session, ...sessions]);
+       setSelectedSession(session);
+       setIsSetupModalOpen(false);
+       toast.success('会话创建成功');
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('创建会话失败:', error);
+       throw error;
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleStartSession = async () =&gt; {
+     if (!selectedSession) return;
+ 
+     try {
+       await brainstormService.startSession(selectedSession.id);
+       toast.success('讨论已启动');
+       // 重新加载会话状态
+       const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(selectedSession.id);
+       setSelectedSession(updated);
+       startPolling(selectedSession.id);
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('启动讨论失败:', error);
+       toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '启动讨论失败');
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleStopSession = async () =&gt; {
+     if (!selectedSession) return;
+ 
+     try {
+       await brainstormService.stopSession(selectedSession.id);
+       toast.success('讨论已停止');
+       stopPolling();
+       // 重新加载会话状态
+       const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(selectedSession.id);
+       setSelectedSession(updated);
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('停止讨论失败:', error);
+       toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '停止讨论失败');
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleDeleteSession = async (sessionId: string) =&gt; {
+     if (!confirm('确定要删除这个会话吗？')) return;
+ 
+     try {
+       await brainstormService.deleteSession(sessionId);
+       setSessions(sessions.filter(s =&gt; s.id !== sessionId));
+       if (selectedSession?.id === sessionId) {
+         setSelectedSession(null);
+         setMessages([]);
+       }
+       toast.success('会话已删除');
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('删除会话失败:', error);
+       toast.error('删除会话失败');
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getStatusBadge = (status: string) =&gt; {
+     const badges = {
+       draft: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800',
+       active: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800',
+       completed: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800',
+       stopped: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800',
+     };
+     return badges[status as keyof typeof badges] || badges.draft;
+   };
+ 
+   const getStatusText = (status: string) =&gt; {
+     const texts = {
+       draft: '草稿',
+       active: '进行中',
+       completed: '已完成',
+       stopped: '已停止',
+     };
+     return texts[status as keyof typeof texts] || status;
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-gray-50"&gt;
+       &lt;TopNavigation /&gt;
+       
+       &lt;div className="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden"&gt;
+         {/* 左侧会话列表 */}
+         &lt;div className="w-80 bg-white border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
+             &lt;h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900"&gt;头脑风暴工作室&lt;/h2&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               onClick={() =&gt; setIsSetupModalOpen(true)}
+               className="flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-white bg-blue-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors"
+             &gt;
+               &lt;Plus className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;

+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-600 line-clamp-2 mb-2"&gt;{session.topic}&lt;/p&gt;

+                       &lt;span className="flex items-center space-x-1"&gt;
+                         &lt;Users className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
+                         &lt;span&gt;{session.participants?.length || 0} 位专家&lt;/span&gt;
+                       &lt;/span&gt;
+                       &lt;span className="flex items-center space-x-1"&gt;
+                         &lt;MessageSquare className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
+                         &lt;span&gt;{session.messageCount || 0} 条消息&lt;/span&gt;
+                       &lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;

+                     &lt;h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-2"&gt;{selectedSession.title}&lt;/h1&gt;
+                     &lt;div className="flex items-center space-x-4 text-sm text-gray-600"&gt;
+                       &lt;span className="flex items-center space-x-1"&gt;

+                         &lt;span&gt;话题：{selectedSession.topic}&lt;/span&gt;

+   );
+ };

+ export default BrainstormPage;

头脑风暴群聊功能已实现。总结如下：

## 实现完成总结

### 后端实现

1. **数据库层**
   - 创建了 `create-brainstorm-tables.sql` 迁移脚本
   - 实现了三个数据表：`brainstorm_sessions`、`brainstorm_participants`、`brainstorm_messages`

2. **数据模型** (`backend/src/models/Brainstorm.ts`)
   - `BrainstormSessionModel` - 会话管理
   - `BrainstormParticipantModel` - 参与者管理
   - `BrainstormMessageModel` - 消息管理
   - 包含表初始化逻辑

3. **服务层**
   - `BrainstormService` - 业务逻辑封装
   - `BrainstormOrchestrator` - 核心编排器，负责并行调度多个 Agent

4. **API 路由** (`backend/src/routes/brainstorm.ts`)
   - 完整的 RESTful API，包括会话 CRUD、参与者管理、启动/停止讨论、消息查询等

### 前端实现

1. **类型定义** (`frontend/src/types/brainstorm.ts`)
   - 完整的 TypeScript 类型定义

2. **服务层** (`frontend/src/services/brainstormService.ts`)
   - 封装所有后端 API 调用

3. **UI 组件**
   - `ExpertSelector` - 专家角色选择器
   - `BrainstormMessageList` - 消息列表（按轮次分组）
   - `BrainstormSummary` - 讨论总结展示
   - `BrainstormSetupModal` - 会话配置弹窗

4. **主页面** (`frontend/src/pages/BrainstormPage.tsx`)
   - 会话列表和详情展示
   - 实时消息轮询
   - 讨论控制（启动/停止）
   - 总结展示

### 核心特性

1. **并行 Agent 协作** - 多个专家 Agent 同时参与讨论
2. **自由讨论模式** - 所有 Agent 并行分析并各自发言
3. **用户选择角色** - 从现有 AI 角色库中选择参与讨论的专家
4. **持久化保存** - 所有讨论记录保存到数据库
5. **智能总结** - 讨论结束后自动生成总结
6. **多种终止条件** - 支持手动停止、最大轮次限制、共识检测（V2）

### 使用方式

1. 访问 `/brainstorm` 页面
2. 点击"新建"创建会话
3. 选择话题和参与专家
4. 配置终止条件
5. 点击"开始讨论"启动
6. 实时查看讨论进展
7. 讨论结束后查看总结

所有代码已通过 lint 检查，功能已实现。可以开始测试使用。

+   private async executeRoundRobin(
+     session: BrainstormSessionDTO,
+     participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],
+     roundNumber: number
+   ): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {
+     const messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[] = [];
+     
+     // 按 sortOrder 排序参与者
+     const sortedParticipants = [...participants].sort((a, b) =&gt; a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder);
+     
+     // 获取历史消息（用于构建上下文）
+     const historyMessages = await brainstormMessageModel.getBySessionId(session.id);
+ 
+     // 依次执行每个参与者
+     for (let i = 0; i &lt; sortedParticipants.length; i++) {
+       const participant = sortedParticipants[i];
+       
+       // 构建查询，包含之前参与者的发言
+       const queries = this.buildQueriesForParticipants(
+         session,
+         sortedParticipants,
+         [...historyMessages, ...messages], // 包含本轮已发言的消息
+         roundNumber,
+         i // 当前发言者的索引
+       );
+       const query = queries[i];
+       const conversationId = &#96;${session.id}_${participant.id}&#96;;
+

+           query,
+           conversationId,
+           {
+             topic: session.topic,
+             description: session.description,
+             roundNumber,
+             participantName: participant.displayName || participant.aiRole?.name || '专家',
+             turnIndex: i,
+             totalTurns: sortedParticipants.length,

+         );

+             totalTokens: result.usage.totalTokens,
+             model: result.metadata?.model,
+             finishReason: result.metadata?.finishReason,
+           },
+         });
+         
+         messages.push(message);

+         moderatorRoleId,
+         moderatorQuery,
+         conversationId,

+           topic: session.topic,
+           description: session.description,
+           roundNumber,
+           participantCount: participants.length,
+         }
+       );
+ 
+       // 创建主持人参与者记录（如果不存在）
+       let moderatorParticipant = participants.find(p =&gt; p.aiRoleId === moderatorRoleId);

+ import { BrainstormSession, BrainstormMessage, BrainstormParticipant } from '@/types/brainstorm';
+ 
+ /**
+  * 导出讨论记录为 Markdown
+  */
+ export function exportToMarkdown(
+   session: BrainstormSession,
+   messages: BrainstormMessage[],
+   participants?: BrainstormParticipant[]
+ ): string {
+   let content = &#96;# ${session.title}\n\n&#96;;
+   content += &#96;**讨论话题**: ${session.topic}\n\n&#96;;
+   
+   if (session.description) {
+     content += &#96;**话题描述**: ${session.description}\n\n&#96;;
+   }
+ 
+   if (participants &amp;&amp; participants.length &gt; 0) {
+     content += &#96;**参与专家**: ${participants.map(p =&gt; p.displayName || p.aiRole?.name || '专家').join('、')}\n\n&#96;;
+   }
+ 
+   content += &#96;---\n\n&#96;;
+ 
+   // 按轮次分组
+   const messagesByRound = new Map&lt;number, BrainstormMessage[]&gt;();
+   messages.forEach(msg =&gt; {
+     if (!messagesByRound.has(msg.roundNumber)) {
+       messagesByRound.set(msg.roundNumber, []);
+     }
+     messagesByRound.get(msg.roundNumber)!.push(msg);
+   });
+ 
+   const sortedRounds = Array.from(messagesByRound.keys()).sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);
+ 
+   for (const round of sortedRounds) {
+     content += &#96;## 第 ${round} 轮讨论\n\n&#96;;
+     const roundMessages = messagesByRound.get(round)!;
+ 
+     for (const msg of roundMessages) {
+       const isUser = msg.messageType === 'user' || msg.participantId === null;
+       const participant = participants?.find(p =&gt; p.id === msg.participantId);
+       const name = isUser ? '我' : (participant?.displayName || participant?.aiRole?.name || '未知专家');
+ 
+       content += &#96;### ${name}\n\n&#96;;
+       content += &#96;${msg.content}\n\n&#96;;
+       content += &#96;*${new Date(msg.createdAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}*\n\n&#96;;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   if (session.summary) {
+     content += &#96;---\n\n&#96;;
+     content += &#96;## 讨论总结\n\n&#96;;
+     content += &#96;${session.summary}\n\n&#96;;
+   }
+ 
+   return content;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 导出讨论记录为纯文本
+  */
+ export function exportToText(
+   session: BrainstormSession,
+   messages: BrainstormMessage[],
+   participants?: BrainstormParticipant[]
+ ): string {
+   let content = &#96;${session.title}\n&#96;;
+   content += &#96;${'='.repeat(session.title.length)}\n\n&#96;;
+   content += &#96;讨论话题: ${session.topic}\n&#96;;
+   
+   if (session.description) {
+     content += &#96;话题描述: ${session.description}\n&#96;;
+   }
+ 
+   if (participants &amp;&amp; participants.length &gt; 0) {
+     content += &#96;参与专家: ${participants.map(p =&gt; p.displayName || p.aiRole?.name || '专家').join('、')}\n&#96;;
+   }
+ 
+   content += &#96;\n${'-'.repeat(50)}\n\n&#96;;
+ 
+   // 按轮次分组
+   const messagesByRound = new Map&lt;number, BrainstormMessage[]&gt;();
+   messages.forEach(msg =&gt; {
+     if (!messagesByRound.has(msg.roundNumber)) {
+       messagesByRound.set(msg.roundNumber, []);
+     }
+     messagesByRound.get(msg.roundNumber)!.push(msg);
+   });
+ 
+   const sortedRounds = Array.from(messagesByRound.keys()).sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);
+ 
+   for (const round of sortedRounds) {
+     content += &#96;第 ${round} 轮讨论\n&#96;;
+     content += &#96;${'-'.repeat(20)}\n\n&#96;;
+     const roundMessages = messagesByRound.get(round)!;
+ 
+     for (const msg of roundMessages) {
+       const isUser = msg.messageType === 'user' || msg.participantId === null;
+       const participant = participants?.find(p =&gt; p.id === msg.participantId);
+       const name = isUser ? '我' : (participant?.displayName || participant?.aiRole?.name || '未知专家');
+ 
+       content += &#96;${name}:\n&#96;;
+       content += &#96;${msg.content}\n\n&#96;;
+       content += &#96;[${new Date(msg.createdAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}]\n\n&#96;;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   if (session.summary) {
+     content += &#96;${'-'.repeat(50)}\n\n&#96;;
+     content += &#96;讨论总结\n&#96;;
+     content += &#96;${'-'.repeat(20)}\n\n&#96;;
+     content += &#96;${session.summary}\n\n&#96;;
+   }
+ 
+   return content;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 导出讨论记录
+  */
+ export function exportDiscussion(
+   session: BrainstormSession,
+   messages: BrainstormMessage[],
+   participants: BrainstormParticipant[] | undefined,
+   format: 'txt' | 'md' = 'md'
+ ): void {
+   let content: string;
+   let mimeType: string;
+   let extension: string;
+ 
+   if (format === 'md') {
+     content = exportToMarkdown(session, messages, participants);
+     mimeType = 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8';
+     extension = 'md';
+   } else {
+     content = exportToText(session, messages, participants);
+     mimeType = 'text/plain;charset=utf-8';
+     extension = 'txt';
+   }
+ 
+   const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType });
+   const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
+   const link = document.createElement('a');
+   link.href = url;
+   link.download = &#96;${session.title}_讨论记录_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.${extension}&#96;;
+   document.body.appendChild(link);
+   link.click();
+   document.body.removeChild(link);
+   URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+ }
+ 
```

所有扩展功能已实现。总结如下：

## 实现完成总结

### 已实现的扩展功能

1. **讨论模式切换** ✅
   - 支持并行模式（所有 Agent 同时发言）
   - 支持轮流发言模式（Agent 按顺序依次发言）
   - 前端配置界面支持模式选择

2. **主持人模式** ✅
   - 支持选择主持人角色
   - 每轮讨论开始时主持人先发言
   - 主持人可以总结和引导讨论

3. **用户参与功能** ✅
   - 用户可以在讨论中插入观点
   - 用户消息显示为绿色背景，区分 Agent 消息
   - 支持回复特定消息（通过 replyToId）

4. **反应式讨论** ✅
   - 消息支持 `replyToId` 字段
   - Agent 和用户都可以回复特定消息
   - 消息列表显示回复关系

5. **导出格式** ✅
   - 支持 Markdown 格式导出
   - 支持纯文本格式导出
   - 导出包含完整讨论记录和总结

6. **超时处理和错误恢复** ✅
   - 单个 Agent 5分钟超时保护
   - 整轮讨论 10分钟超时保护
   - 总讨论时间 1小时超时保护
   - 连续错误检测（最多3次后停止）
   - 错误消息自动保存

7. **数据一致性优化** ✅
   - 批量创建消息时顺序处理确保一致性
   - 错误处理不中断整个批次
   - 数据库操作增加错误恢复机制

### 技术要点

- **超时机制**：使用 `Promise.race` 实现超时控制
- **错误恢复**：连续错误检测和自动停止机制
- **数据一致性**：顺序处理批量操作，避免并发冲突
- **用户体验**：实时轮询、用户输入、导出功能

### 使用方式

1. 创建会话时选择讨论模式（并行/轮流）
2. 可选择启用主持人模式并选择主持人角色
3. 讨论进行中，用户可以在底部输入框插入观点
4. 讨论结束后可导出为 Markdown 或文本格式
5. 系统自动处理超时和错误，确保讨论稳定进行

所有功能已通过 lint 检查，可以开始测试使用。
